newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Volume rose to 4.6 billion yuan from 2.2 billion yuan on Thursday, with the seven-day contract being the most active.
Traders said some short-term financial centres continued to be major buyers with most of their trading focused on the early-maturing contracts.
"The rises in the domestic A share market since Tuesday are the most important factor," one trader said.
"Turnover recovered today, indicating that some big state-run banks which had cut their trading recently had returned to the market," he added.
Traders said the results of a national meeting of bankers next week could be important for the interbank market.
